english: I disagree that something that isn't related to existence would an example of something which is (1) contradictory to what is contradictory to existence; and also (2) not contradictory to what is not contradictory to existence; and also (3) related to what is related to existence; and also (4) not related to what is not related to existence. Suppose you do disagree. Let's consider then something which isn't related to existence. It is too an example of something which is (1) contradictory to what is contradictory to existence; and also (2) not contradictory to what is not contradictory to existence; and also (3) related to what is related to existence; and also (4) not related to what is not related to existence; Because, first of all, it is contradictory to what is contradictory to existence.  And at the same time it is, secondly, not contradictory to what is not contradictory to existence.  Thirdly, it is as well related to what is related to existence.  And fourth, it is not related to what is not related to existence.
